name: Cloudflare Durable Objects Free
free_limit: Workers Free Durable Objects: 100,000 requests/day, 13,000 GB-seconds duration/day and up to 5 GB total SQLite-backed storage
watch_out: Only SQLite-backed Durable Objects can be created on Workers Free; key-value-backed objects are unavailable. SQLite storage has additional daily row-read/write limits (5M reads and 100K writes), and Free limits reset at 00:00 UTC; exceeding them causes errors. Workers request and CPU quotas also apply.
